common.tagline: Air travel grievance redressal - Ministry of Civil Aviation / Airports Authority of India
common.prototype: Prototype - all external systems are simulated

landing.title: File and track air travel grievances in one place
landing.sub: Flights, airports, baggage, refunds, wheelchair assistance. Your complaint is routed to the right airline, airport or authority and tracked until it is resolved.
landing.pPassengerD: Register, file, track, reopen and give feedback
landing.pAdminD: KPIs, SLA, rules, watch list, reports
landing.pDemoD: Post on the left, watch PACR detect it on the right
landing.demoNote: Demo accounts and the OTP (123456) are listed in the README. No real SMS, e-mail or social platform is connected.

auth.guestConsent: Save my details and create an account for tracking later
auth.guestNote: Guest access needs only a mobile number or e-mail verified by OTP.
auth.name: Full name
auth.passwordHint: At least 8 characters with upper-case, lower-case, digit and special character.
auth.staffNote: Staff, agents and administrators sign in with their password.

form.title: File a grievance
form.subtitle: Takes about two minutes. Fields marked * are mandatory.

cat.airport: Airport related (hygiene, charging points, facilities, security)
cat.ground: On-ground (wheelchair, airport stores, taxi, meet & greet)

form.name: Your name
form.contactHint: Mobile number or e-mail is required.
form.descHint: Mention airline, flight number, airport and what happened. Urgent medical, medicine or exam-document cases are auto-prioritised.
form.attachHint: PDF, JPG or PNG, up to 10 MB each
form.consent: I have read the privacy notice and consent to AirSewa storing my contact information to process this grievance.
form.tat: Standard response time for this category: {h} hours
form.loginFirst: Please login or continue as guest to file a grievance.

ticket.rating: How satisfied are you with the resolution?
ticket.confirm: I confirm the issue is resolved
ticket.closedNote: Closed. Thank you for your feedback.
ticket.holdNote: The officer needs more information from you:
ticket.resolvedNote: The stakeholder marked this as resolved. Please confirm or reopen.

track.title: Track a flight or grievance
track.subscribed: You will receive updates (Simulated - see Notification Log).
